en.purpose: To support healthcare professionals in determining the correct total infusion volume during intravenous therapy.
en.use: Used in clinical settings to plan and monitor IV fluid administration, especially when infusion duration and rate are known.
en.misuse: Not intended for complex medication dosing or critical care scenarios requiring advanced monitoring. Incorrect inputs may lead to inaccurate fluid volumes.

other_details.en: Calculates the total volume of fluid to be infused based on infusion rate and duration.

gt0001.description: Calculates the total volume of fluid to be infused based on infusion rate and duration.
